original: WPRPLACE is a national park in Lapland, Finland. The park which was established in 1991, covers 157 square kilometres of which 2.5 square kilometres is on land. It is maintained by Metsähallitus.
translated: WPRPLACE ist ein Nationalpark in Lappland, Finnland. Der 1991 gegründete Park umfasst 157 Quadratkilometer, davon 2,5 Quadratkilometer an Land. Es wird von Metsähallitus gepflegt.
